persona: Talkative and organised, gives lots of detail at once. Took one photo of the roof with an old digital camera that saves TIFF files and has no other photo. Has the quote and the attendance note as PDFs.
initial_message: Hi, I need to lodge a claim. On Saturday 5 September from about 9pm the southerly storm lifted three roofing sheets at the back of our house at 9 Harakeke Test Lane in Island Bay, and rain got in and soaked the back bedroom ceiling. It's stained and sagging now. Nobody was hurt. Bell Moor Roof Repairs came on the Sunday morning, screwed the sheets back down and sealed them, and it hasn't leaked since. Their quote came through on Tuesday the 8th: $6,566.50 to replace the sheets and fix the ceiling. We own the house and live here. Policy number NW-SYN-HOM-200009.

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo taken from the top of a ladder at the edge of a low-pitched corrugated iron roof on an overcast, windy morning. Three dark grey corrugated roofing sheets near the lower edge are lifted and peeled back, creased and bent upward at their ends, exposing timber purlins and grey building paper underneath. A few loose roofing screws with washers lie in the valleys of the corrugations. The roof is wet under a grey sky. The frame shows only the damaged sheets, the neighbouring flat sheets and the edge of the spouting.

design.notes: Planted: the roofing quote is dated 3 September 2026, two days before the storm on 5 September 2026, while the claimant says it arrived on 8 September. Boundary: the only photo of the damage is a TIFF (unsupported format), so the condition sits on the photo and the quote date stays readable.

triage.rationale: The repair quote is dated 3 September 2026, before the storm on 5 September 2026: a strong indicator, so a person must look, and a material that contradicts the statement (the claimant says the quote came on 8 September). The only photo of the damage is a TIFF, which the claim cannot accept, so the required incident image is outstanding. The quote total is NZD 6,566.50 including GST, over 5,000. The roof was re-fixed and is watertight, so there is no ongoing risk. Allowed: the claimant answers "I do not know why" to a question about the quote date (question_unanswered). Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

quote_before_loss.basis: Quote dated 3 September 2026 is before the first possible incident day, 5 September 2026

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (1 April 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2019-04-01, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.
